key_provisions_or_claims: Panama represented by Senacyt at the VII OAS Meeting of Ministers of Science and Technology, 12-13 December 2024
Panama supports safe, trustworthy, ethical AI protecting democratic principles and human rights
Final declaration recognizes the urgency of regulatory frameworks for safe and ethical AI
Panama highlights its semiconductor technology centre with the Universidad Tecnológica de Panamá
annotation.summary_en: Senacyt press release on Panama's participation in the VII OAS Meeting of Ministers of Science and Technology (December 2024). Panama reaffirms support for safe, trustworthy, ethical and sustainable AI, notes the final declaration's call for regulatory frameworks, and highlights its semiconductor centre and scientific diplomacy role.

annotation.title_en: Panama promotes an ethical and sustainable artificial intelligence agenda at the OAS
